0x1018AD80.name: Blend_FindPrevious
0x1018AD80.evidence: walks the list from owner+0x10 through +8 and returns the entry before this one, or 0 when it is not in the list

0x1018ADA0.name: Blend_FreeResult
0x1018ADA0.evidence: when the object at +0x20 has bit 2 of its first dword set, frees it with Mem_FreeObject, then clears +0x20
0x1018ADA0.summary: Frees the blend's result object when it owns it.

0x1018ADE0.name: Blend_Update
0x1018ADE0.evidence: called by Blend_UpdateOnce; updates the chained blend at +8, takes the blend fraction from (+0x18 minus +0x14) over +0x18, and when the two sources are set blends them with FUN_10189490 into a new result from FUN_1018AEB0 after freeing the old one
0x1018ADE0.summary: Advances a blend and blends its two sources into a new result.

0x1018AEB0.name: Blend_AllocResult

0x1018AEB0.summary: Allocates a blend result object that the blend owns.
